text:
maya: Hey team — CI is red on my branch `feature/embedder-optim` after I rebased onto main. Tests failing only on CI :confused: Locally everything passes. Failing test: TestKVPrefetch::test_prefetch_on_rebase

maya: failure snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 3 but got 2
file: tests/test_kv_prefetch.py:42
  def test_prefetch_on_rebase():
    assert len(prefetched) == 3
```

ci-bot: Build #7890 failed — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7890 (CI shard: unit-3)

sam: @maya do you know the last commit on main that was green vs the head of your branch? if you can bisect that space it's quickest.

maya: last green on main was `a1b2c3d` (2024-11-02). my branch head is `d4e5f6g` after the rebase.

jonah: I can bisect if you want. Maya, can you share perms or the repo location? otherwise paste the failing commit range.

maya: repo: github.com/redwood/serving (my fork: maya/serving). I don't have time atm — if you can run bisect that'd be amazing.

sam: Steps I usually run:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b bisect-temp origin/main
git bisect start HEAD a1b2c3d
# then either manually test or run the CI test script
git bisect run ./scripts/ci-run-kv-tests.sh
```
Note: ci-run-kv-tests.sh approximates CI env.

jonah: Kickoff done on my machine. First failing commit shown as `f7c8d9e` — a merge from main that touched kv prefetch assumptions. Commit message: "fix(kv): tweak prefetch batch sizing"

akshay: That commit also changed fixture order in tests/fixtures/kv_data.json — likely reason. The test expecting 3 items is brittle to ordering.

sam: Can you paste the diff?

akshay: quick diff:
```diff
-  "prefetch_order": ["a","b","c"],
+  "prefetch_order": ["b","a","c"],
```
Looks like main introduced nondeterminism in the fixture. CI run uses a deterministic seed that changed after you rebased.

maya: that explains local pass (I have a different seed). Ugh.

sam: Two options: make test order-insensitive (preferred), or pin the seed in CI run. Which is quicker for a hotfix?

jonah: For immediate unblocking, revert the fixture reorder in your branch and push a tiny fix. I'll also open a follow-up to make the test robust.

maya: Pushed patch `fix: pin kv fixture order` -> commit `h1i2j3k` and triggered a rebuild.

rerun-bot: Rerun requested for build #7890 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/7890/rebuild/1 (triggered by maya)

ci-bot: Build #7890 (rebuild 1) started on unit-3

ci-bot: Build #7890 (rebuild 1) succeeded — all tests green :tada:

maya: Awesome, green on CI now. Thanks @jonah @akshay @sam for the quick triage. I'll follow up with a proper test hardening PR.

sam: Nice! Please link the follow-up so we can make the test less flaky.

maya: Will do — creating the issue and PR later today. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
